test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Among seven sisters T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z; U is elder than only four other sisters. V is elder than W. T is elder than Y. X is elder than one person only that is Z who is the youngest among all sisters. U is elder than T. Given that no two sisters have the same age, find who is the eldest sister.
solution:
As per the given statements,

1) U is elder than only four other sisters.

→ _ > _ > U > _ > _ > _ > _

2) X is elder than one person only that is Z who is the youngest among all sisters.

→ _ > _ > U > _ > _ > X > Z

3) T is elder than Y.

4) U is elder than T.

→ _ > _ > U > T > Y > X > Z

5) V is elder than W.

→ V > W > U > T > Y > X > Z

Here, we can see that V is the eldest sister.

Hence, the correct answer is **"V"**.
